title: Visustella Victory Aftermath Level Up Bust Help

posts.author: K-apple
posts.body:
I am currently using the Victory Aftermath Plugin from Visustella but I can't seem to get the Victory Bust to appear. I can get the image bust to appear for dialogue boxes but not the full image bust. Its supposed to look like the image below (taken from the guide on the website.)
But for some reason mine keeps coming out like this...
Here are some of my settings in the plug in menu...
If anyone who knows how this plug in works, can help me that be appreciated.

posts.author: rpgLord69
posts.body: I think it needs the Main Menu Core portrait setting. Do you have the busts appearing on your main menu?

I see what's happening now. The Portrait1 naming refers to where they are in the actor database. For Actor 1 I need to make a Portrait 11 image. And for Actor 10 I need a Portrait110 image. I thought I needed to alter the code to account for each individual actor, but the code already accounts for that, and I just need to make the appropriate images and name them properly to tie them together.
Thank you so much for this.
I'm now working on the portrait boxes and already resized them to make sure they appear where I want them to when a character levels up.
Again thank you so much for this. Now I can easily design my menus without having worry about plugin conflict.
